segments.Густую (зерновую, фруктовую) брагу стоит: Thick (grain, fruit) wash should be homogenized beforehand, and an antifoam, 20-40 ml per 100 l of wash, should be used against foam
segments.Слив барды лучше делать ниже уровня выхо: Drain the stillage below the level where vapor leaves the column - by gravity, without extra back pressure
segments.Оптимизация подбирает мощность и подачу: Optimization selects power and feed from the stillage and vapor temperatures and stops on flooding or when the pressure reaches the working ceiling (see the hint at the «Flooding pressure» field) - but on pressure only after the optimum has been found at least once. Work reduces the feed if the stillage is colder than the reference temperature («End T (stillage)») by more than «Delta», if the vapor is colder than the «T vapor» setting, or if the pressure is at the ceiling, and on a sharp drop (a strong fall in stillage temperature) it cuts the feed at once by a whole «Feed step
segments.Мощность и подача из сообщения «Оптимиза: The power and feed from the message «Optimization finished: Mo=..., Po=...» are usually repeated from run to run within 5-10%. A line of type O inherits power and feed from line S, so if you enter these Mo and Po in program line S, the next Optimization will start its search near the working point instead of from scratch
